pages.title: About Scarlen Lopez — NYC Creator & Marketer
pages.description: Hi, I’m Scar - an NYC-based content creator and marketing graduate who loves turning everyday moments into stories that inspire connection. I blend creativity with strategy to create content that feels authentic to my audience and helps brands build meaningful relationships.
